ageGate.question: Are you over the age of 21?
ageGate.denied: We're sorry, but you do not meet the required age to enter this website.
ageGate.mechanism: Bootstrap modal #ageGateModal, backdrop static, keyboard off; #mainContent stays hidden until passed. "Yes" reveals the store list; choosing a store sets localStorage agePass_v2=true and cookie agePass_v2=true (max-age 31536000, one year) and navigates to the store page. "No" shows the denied text only. Same markup on ALL_91.
